name: Release v0.7.10
body:
## Features

* **State machine bypass fix** — Rule-based transitions, POST /transitions endpoint, transition graph API (#164)
* **rmcp ServerInfo to ServerConfig migration** — Migrated rmcp ServerInfo to ServerConfig (#161)

## Chores

* Revert: removed transition graph surface; refreshed lockfiles, bumped manifest floors
* serde_yaml migration, CI pin
* Multiple dependabot bumps (rmcp 3.1.4 to 3.2.0, tower-http, tabled, tokio-util, noyalib)
